structured.feedback: Meets the core requirements: about 250 words, Markdown subheadings, no links, clear feature/benefit split, active voice, and a CTA. Minor issues: the 30-day guarantee is stated unconditionally when the source makes it conditional, "without worrying about touch-ups" slightly overpromises given reviews about reapplying under the eye, and the "Gentle, Reliable Application" section is thin and leans on review paraphrase.
